prompt: Silent fictional small-office supply kit, six seconds, wide 16:9. Photographic live-action appearance in a real small office: subtly textured pale-grey painted wall, light natural oak floor with fine wood grain, soft window daylight from outside the shot, natural shadows and realistic material detail. Exactly four product groups stand in one straight row from left to right with clear gaps: (1) a cylindrical stainless French coffee press with a visible plunger lid and a plain ivory ceramic mug together on a plain box; (2) a clear unlabelled spray bottle with a folded fabric cleaning cloth on a plain ivory box; (3) one generic ergonomic charcoal mesh office task chair with adjustable lumbar back, armrests and a five-spoke star base on casters, on the floor; (4) a neat stack of loose blank white printer paper with visible sheet edges on a plain box. The boxes under groups 1 and 4 are matte, muted, dark dusty grey-indigo (#44416F), desaturated, not royal blue or saturated violet. The middle box and mug are warm ivory (#F6F4EF). All packaging is blank. Locked-off static camera: no pan, orbit, push-in or cuts. Wide framing with generous empty margin on both sides; every prop and every chair wheel remains fully in frame throughout. The objects stay stationary at realistic scale. No other furniture, electronics, plants, windows or wall art in view. No writing, letters, numbers, stickers, labels, barcodes, logos, symbols, signage, prices, UI, mascots, slogans or real trade dress. No people, hands or faces. No soundtrack.
